summary: Prorated license fee line posted as usage token charge on finalized invoice
description: Issue summary: Customer reports a charge on their finalized invoice that appears to be a prorated license/platform fee but is reflected under 'usage tokens' with quantity and rate. Impact: Customer was billed $3,720 unexpectedly; they are contesting the invoice and paused auto-pay. Environment: prod | us-east. Steps to reproduce: 1) Customer upgraded Dedicated plan on 2026-02-18; 2) System generated prorated adjustment on 2026-03-01; 3) Finalized invoice 2026-03-05 shows line item 'tokens' instead of 'license_prorate' tag; 4) Invoice exported to billing CSV includes usage meter id 847392-report. Logs: attached billing export snippets and invoice PDF (links in comments).
requested_action: Please investigate why prorated license fee was attributed to usage tokens line and correct invoice. Provide provisional credit and advise on rollback to allow autopay.
comments: 2026-03-10 11:02 AM - Jenna Morales (Support): Opened ticket after customer email. Attached invoice PDF and CSV extract. Customer requests provisional hold on autopay.
2026-03-10 13:18 PM - Billing Eng (Arman Patel): Acknowledged. Tagging billing team; will triage postback logs and rate table. Asked for customer's org id and upgrade event timestamps.
2026-03-11 09:45 AM - Customer (Elena Park, BrightLeaf): Provided org id BL-908 and upgrade event server-side timestamp 2026-02-18T16:04:22Z. Customer confirms autopay was disabled.

2026-03-11 15:22 PM - Arman Patel (Billing Eng): Found anomaly in postback reconciler: prorate_generator emitted adjustment with tag 'license_prorate' but aggregator map fell back to 'usage' due to cache miss on rate-metadata service. Reproduced locally with test vector. Opening PR to add defensive mapping.

2026-03-12 10:05 AM - Support (Jenna Morales): Notified customer that we're working on provisional credit and will issue correction once reconciler fix is deployed. Asked finance to hold collections for INV-2026-03-00578.
investigation_notes: Checked reconciler logs for invoice id INV-2026-03-00578; saw 3 postbacks: prorate(2026-03-01T02:12Z), reserve_adjust(2026-03-01T02:13Z), finalize(2026-03-05T04:01Z).
prorate_generator v2.4 emitted metric 'license_prorate' with rate_id RP-774; rate-metadata cache returned null at time of aggregation causing fallback to 'usage' category.

Rate metadata service incidents recorded on 2026-03-01 02:10-02:15 UTC (ops incident #INC-8841). Postback ordering edge-case in reconciler combined prorate with microbatch usage and assigned usage_rate_id.
Reproduced in staging by simulating cache miss; invoice lines map to 'tokens' when rate metadata unavailable and default_policy=legacy_usage.
Finance impact: $3,720 misclassified; legal/taxation might be affected if reclassified after finalization.
notes_for_finance: Customer requests provisional credit of $3,720 pending corrected invoice. Recommend applying temporary credit memo CM-PR-672413 and hold collections. If reconciler fix deploys, re-issue corrected invoice and reverse provisional credit.
next_steps: 1) Validate reconciler PR and deploy to staging (Arman). 2) Run reconciliation job to re-process invoice postbacks for INV-2026-03-00578 (Billing ops). 3) Issue provisional credit memo and inform customer success (Support). 4) Post-deploy verification and invoice correction (Billing + Finance).
